settings.editor: Peptides are short amino acid chains. It is the body's most precise signalling molecules. Smaller than proteins, they carry targeted biological messages that influence everything from metabolism to tissue repair.

The human body produces hundreds of peptides naturally: insulin, oxytocin, growth-hormone releasing hormone, and countless neuropeptides. Each one instructs specific cells to grow, recover, release hormones, or initiate metabolic processes.

Peptides bind to specific receptors on cell surfaces, triggering precise intracellular signals that adjust gene expression, enzyme activity, and hormone production. Because each peptide-receptor interaction is highly selective, even trace amounts of the right molecule can produce a measurable biological response, making peptides uniquely powerful tools in modern research.

While some peptides are isolated from natural tissue, the overwhelming majority used in laboratories today are synthesised via solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS). This technique builds the chain one amino acid at a time, enabling purity verification at every step and allowing researchers to explore sequences that do not exist in nature.

Peptide research spans metabolic regulation, tissue repair, immune modulation, growth signalling, mood and cognition, sleep physiology, and longevity science. New candidate molecules are evaluated every year, making this one of the most dynamic frontiers in pre-clinical research.

Impurities or truncated sequences alter in-vitro behaviour and undermine reproducibility. Every ONYX Research batch is independently verified by third-party laboratories using HPLC and mass spectrometry, with a reported purity of at least 99%. Lyophilised peptides should be stored frozen, reconstituted with a sterile solvent, and used within the manufacturer's recommended window.

Every vial ships with a unique authentication code printed on the label. Enter it on our Check Code page to view the independently verified purity figure and the exact date of testing giving you complete confidence in every experiment.
